voxymap.ui.title: Voxy Map
voxymap.ui.hint: %s close   Scroll zoom   Drag pan   %s center on player
voxymap.config.skipWorldRender: Skip world rendering while the map is open
voxymap.config.debugEnabled: Debug panel (press Q in the map)
voxymap.config.comment.1: Automatically regenerate the map when the player moves far away or after the initial delay
voxymap.config.comment.2: Refresh once the player moved this many chunks since the last update
voxymap.config.comment.3: Refresh once this many minutes after joining a world (0 disables the initial refresh)
voxymap.config.comment.5: Map resolution: blocks per pixel (1 = sharpest and slowest, 4 = coarse and fast)
voxymap.config.comment.6: Highest Voxy LOD level to merge (0-4). Lower values skip far coarse data
voxymap.config.comment.7: Read the sea level from the world (adapts to terrain mods)
voxymap.config.comment.8: Sea level used when autoSeaLevel is disabled
voxymap.config.comment.10: Default palette: current, gradient, gmt, nautical, gradient-turbo, gradient-soft
voxymap.config.comment.12: Drop contour fragments smaller than this many pixels
voxymap.config.comment.15: Initial zoom when opening the map
voxymap.config.comment.16: Stretch the land colour ramp to the world's actual height range
voxymap.config.comment.17: Blur the water depth to smooth out sea-floor speckles
voxymap.config.comment.18: Water blur radius in map pixels
voxymap.config.comment.20: Remove isolated height outliers on land
voxymap.config.comment.21: Fill small interior data holes with the local median
voxymap.config.comment.23: Show cursor coordinates at the bottom of the screen
voxymap.config.comment.24: Show the control hint in the top-left corner
voxymap.config.comment.25: Offer the teleport entry in the right-click menu
voxymap.config.comment.26: Land only: sea level (green) up to the map's highest point (white); water colours are unchanged
voxymap.config.landMaxRamp: Stretch land palette to map's highest point
voxymap.config.comment.27: How many contour lines span the land height range (higher = denser)
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.title: LOD data may not be ready yet
voxymap.ui.lodWarning.message: It is recommended to wait for LOD generation before refreshing the map. Refresh now?
voxymap.ui.overworldOnly: Only overworld LOD maps are supported for now
voxymap.config.desc.autoRefresh: Automatically refresh the map when the player moves far or after the initial delay
voxymap.config.desc.refreshDistanceChunk: Refresh once the player moved this many chunks
voxymap.config.desc.initialRefreshDelayM: Refresh this many minutes after joining a world (0 disables)
voxymap.config.desc.mapScale: Value 1-8 = blocks per pixel; 1 is sharpest and slowest, 8 coarsest
voxymap.config.desc.maxLodLevel: Highest Voxy LOD level to merge (0-4)
voxymap.config.desc.cacheKeepCount: How many world caches to keep
voxymap.config.desc.autoSeaLevel: Read the sea level from the world
voxymap.config.desc.seaLevelOverride: Sea level used when autoSeaLevel is disabled
voxymap.config.desc.defaultStyle: One of the six palettes (current, gradient, gmt, nautical, ...)
voxymap.config.desc.defaultZoom: Initial zoom for new worlds, or when zoom memory is off
voxymap.config.desc.contourDensity: How many contour lines span the land height range
voxymap.config.desc.minContourArea: Drop contour fragments smaller than this many pixels
voxymap.config.desc.adaptiveColorRamp: Stretch the colour ramp to the world's actual height range
voxymap.config.desc.landMaxRamp: Land only: stretch the ramp to the map's highest point
voxymap.config.desc.waterBlur: Blur the water depth to smooth sea-floor speckles
voxymap.config.desc.waterBlurRadius: Water blur radius in map pixels
voxymap.config.desc.denoise: Remove isolated height outliers on land
voxymap.config.desc.fillHoles: Fill small interior holes with the local median
voxymap.config.desc.showBiomes: Show the biome boundary overlay when opening the map
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelMinArea: Minimum biome area needed to show its name
voxymap.config.desc.biomeLabelBackground: Draw a translucent background behind biome labels
voxymap.config.desc.arrowStyle: Arrow marker style: clean or classic
voxymap.config.desc.showRenderDistance: Show the player render distance as a yellow box
voxymap.config.desc.releaseTexturesOnClo: Release map textures when closing the map (frees VRAM)
voxymap.config.desc.skipWorldRender: Skip world rendering while the map is open
voxymap.config.desc.showCoordinates: Show cursor coordinates at the bottom of the screen
voxymap.config.desc.showHint: Show the control hint in the top-left corner
voxymap.config.desc.teleportEnabled: Offer the teleport entry in the right-click menu
voxymap.config.desc.debugEnabled: Debug panel on Q in the map screen
voxymap.config.desc.rememberZoom: Restore the zoom level the map was last closed with
